title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Conditions: Registration, Term Counting, Rental Cap and Expiry
content:
**1. Registration.** Warranty Coverage is registered automatically on the date the installation is completed, under the plan chosen on the contract at signing; the series' included plan is the default and a higher plan is bought at signing for the upgrade price per unit, and the plan never changes after signing.

**2. Counting.** Every term is counted from the coverage start date in whole years: coverage runs through the day before the anniversary that ends the term, and when that anniversary falls on a day the month lacks, it falls back to the last day of the month.

**3. Lifetime.** A lifetime term lasts as long as the registered owner owns the home.

**4. Rental cap.** While the home is used as a rental property according to the customer profile, every term, lifetime included, is capped at the rental cap counted from the coverage start date; the cap is an override that replaces any longer term and never lengthens a shorter one.

**5. Expiry.** A registration expires when every one of its terms has ended; a registration with any lifetime term does not expire while the registered owner owns the home.

The plan's component terms, the upgrade price per unit, the included plan of each series and the rental cap are the figures of the plan's schedules; the coverage start date is the installation completion date.

## Counting a term — worked dates (hypothetical)

| Coverage start date | Term | Ending anniversary | Last covered day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2036 | 5 years | 15 May 2041 | 14 May 2041 |
| 15 May 2036 | 1 year | 15 May 2037 | 14 May 2037 |
| 29 February 2036 | 1 year | 29 February 2037 does not exist, so 28 February 2037 | 27 February 2037 |

A claim date of 14 May 2041 falls inside the 5-year term in the first row; 15 May 2041 falls outside it.

## Rental cap — cases (hypothetical, with a 10-year cap)

| Term under the plan | Home used as a rental property per the customer profile | Term that applies |
|---|---|---|
| lifetime | yes | 10 years from the coverage start date |
| 20 years | yes | 10 years |
| 5 years | yes | 5 years (the cap never lengthens a shorter term) |
| 20 years | no | 20 years |

## Expiry — cases

- A registration whose terms are all in years expires once the longest of them has ended.
- A registration with a lifetime frame term does not expire while the registered owner owns the home, even after every term in years has ended.
